profile_text:
Role: solo founder of a pre-seed B2B SaaS startup.
Goals: close the seed round, ship v1 to design partners, hire the first engineer.
Urgent: investor replies and term sheets, customer outages or escalations, legal and incorporation deadlines, payroll.
Important: design partner feedback, founding-engineer candidate applications, accelerator and investor updates.
Ignore: student newsletters, campus events, coursework, retail promotions, generic job alerts (not job hunting).
Job targets: none; is hiring, not looking for a job.
Key senders: investors, design partners, candidates, lawyer, accountant.
